description: bigville R10c (274000): THE NIGHTLY JOURNAL -- a graph-native first-person diary. jn_write_entry: when a resident is armed for the night (journal_armed==1, set by the adapter once per night as mechanical world-delivery), the rule MINTS a JournalEntry node that CAPTURES the resident's day FROM THEIR OWN GRAPH STATE -- day / coin / grief / snap-pressure / wellbeing / conflict / chosen-action / backing -- each copied by an Attr term reading the mover, wires wrote_journal (the export reads this edge) + has_entry on the resident's Diary, and clears journal_armed so it fires EXACTLY once per night. NO prose is authored here or in Python: the entry's content is a mechanical render of real graph state (the export formats these attrs into a first-person line, exactly as R10b's `held` export formats real reads). Composes existing Terms (Eq/Attr/Var/Lit) -- zero new Rust. self_load_only; nothing depends_on it; guards on journal_armed absent in every existing path.
